answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh harbor challenge every epoch. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the echo of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. The oasis ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 1yuse.
